d: ADNOC Schools is currently seeking high-performing Biology Teachers for immediate start. The current vacancy is based in ADNOC School - Ruwais Campus, located in the Western Region (Al Dhafra) of Abu Dhabi.
ADNOC Schools are Massachusetts State Curriculum schools in superb facilities in Abu Dhabi City and the Western Region of Abu Dhabi Emirate.

The Massachusetts Curriculum is one of the most highly regarded and successful curricula in the United States, with close links to prestigious higher education institutions such as Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Graduates of ADNOC Schools receive the American High School Diploma - the standard entry qualification for US colleges and universities.
This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.
The successful candidates will be closely aligned with our core values and ethos and possess a genuine understanding and appreciation of the values of the region.
r: Creating a climate for learning that is conducive for outstanding practice
Identifying clear teaching and learning objectives
Setting tasks that challenge students and ensure high levels of interest;
Setting clear targets, building on prior attainment;
Identifying SEN or very able students and ensuring that their needs are met through differentiation;
Providing clear structures for lessons maintaining pace, motivation, and challenge;
Making effective use of assessment for learning;
Making effective use of performance data and key indicators to inform planning and therefore deliver differentiated lessons
Maintaining discipline in accordance with the school’s ‘Behaviour for Learning Policy’ and encouraging good practice with regard to punctuality, behavior, standards of work, and homework;
Using a variety of teaching strategies to:
i. match approach to content, structure information, present a set of key ideas, and use appropriate vocabulary
ii. use effective questioning, listen carefully to students, give attention to errors and misconceptions
iii. select appropriate learning resources and develop study skills through the library, I.C.T., and other learning technologies;
Assess how well learning objectives have been achieved and use them to improve specific aspects of teaching;
Mark students work at least once every two weeks and set targets for progress;
Using performance data to inform planning and therefore ensuring the Learning and Teaching continue to ‘add value’

Assess and record students' progress systematically and keep records to check work is understood and completed, monitor strengths and areas for development, inform planning and recognize the level at which the student is achieving
Assess students as requested by examination bodies, departmental and school procedures
Prepare and present informative reports to parents
Take part in subject development by producing, reviewing, and updating curriculum plans and schemes of work
Keep subject knowledge up-to-date through CPD and professional reading
Attend professional development workshops as appropriate
Undertake additional duties as required by the Principal or Vice Principal as appropriate.
You must be a fully qualified teacher with
Bachelor in Science, Biology or a Bachelor’s Degree in a related subject with PGCE or other teacher qualification with a minimum of 2-year teaching experience in the related field.
A commitment to an extensive enrichment program
Recent and consistent involvement in extra-curricular activities
Respect for all members of your school community
Experience with students for whom English is an additional language
A positive and solution-focused attitude to working life
A clean enhanced Disclosure and Barring Services or Police check
A cover letter and CV including details of two referees should be submitted.
x: We offer an attractive remuneration package including medical cover, flights, furnished accommodation, and children's education allowance. Our future-focused learning model includes both students and staff and so we place a special emphasis on professional development, coaching, and training. Successful candidates will have access to a wide network of professionals and opportunities to lead and contribute to training others as well as developing themselves.

As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volume of applications and robust selection process, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted within 10 business days.

Aldar Education and ADNOC Schools are committed to safeguarding children and young people, and any offer of appointment will be subject to any relevant medical checks and clearance from appropriate safeguarding authorities.

d: The Postal Finance Clerk supports daily postal finance operations for ASAB, ADAB, Optional AUAB, and MSAB locations. This role processes and reconciles postal transactions using USPS POS/RSS or an equivalent postal financial system. The clerk maintains accurate financial records, safeguards accountable funds and stock, prepares required reports, and ensures compliance with USPS policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Various Locations: Ali Al Salem Air Base (ASAB), Kuwait; Al Dhafra Air Base (ADAB), United Arab Emirates; Muwaffaq Salti Air Base (MSAB), Jordan; optional placement at Al Udeid Air Base (AUAB), Qatar

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.
Estimated Starting Salary Range for Postal Finance Clerk: TBD
Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.
r: Process postal retail and financial transactions accurately using USPS POS/RSS or an equivalent postal financial system.
Reconcile daily financial activity, including cash, money orders, stamps, accountable paper, retail transactions, and other postal revenue.
Prepare, review, and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports and supporting documentation.
Identify, research, and resolve discrepancies, shortages, overages, and transaction errors in a timely manner.
Maintain financial records in accordance with USPS requirements, contract requirements, and established internal controls.
Safeguard cash, stamps, money orders, accountable items, and other postal assets.
Support audits, inspections, inventory counts, and financial reviews by providing accurate records and documentation.
Coordinate with postal personnel, site leadership, and customers to resolve finance-related issues.
Assist with administrative tasks related to postal operations, including filing, data entry, reporting, and records retention.
Follow all applicable security, privacy, safety, and ethical standards while handling postal and financial information.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of postal finance operations at ASAB, ADAB, Optional AUAB, and MSAB.
Postal Finance Clerk Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested:
Minimum of two (2) years of experience using USPS POS/RSS or an equivalent postal financial system.
Demonstrated experience processing, balancing, reconciling, and reporting financial transactions.
Working knowledge of postal financial procedures, accountable property controls, and cash-handling practices.
Ability to identify and resolve financial discrepancies with accuracy and attention to detail.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Ability to maintain accurate records and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced operational environment.
Ability to meet all applicable access, security, background screening, and deployment requirements for the assigned work location.
Prior experience supporting USPS operations in an overseas, remote, military, or contingency environment.
Experience supporting postal operations at ASAB, ADAB, AUAB, MSAB, or similar locations.
Experience with USPS financial reporting, audits, inspections, and accountable paper inventory.
Knowledge of USPS retail systems, postal regulations, and standard operating procedures.
Experience working with government contracts or Department of Defense customers.
Associate degree or higher in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field.
